info.name: Xeno
info.description: Organized collection for Xeno integrators. User APIs cover OpenAI-compatible inference, Xeno Client covers the local dashboard API, and Xeno Server covers management and operations APIs.

item.name: User APIs
item.description: OpenAI-compatible application APIs. Use x-access-key for seeded local development or bearer auth after token creation.

item.name: Xeno Client
item.description: Local dashboard and client management APIs exposed by a running Xeno Client.

item.name: Xeno Server

request.description: No authentication headers; expected 401 when authentication is required.
Expected 403 when a credential is used against another tenant.

item.name: Denied - Regular User Sets Tenant Admin

item.description: Xeno Server operator, administration, telemetry, routing, and compatibility APIs.
